notes.title: Notice of Release Date Postponement
notes.notes:
Hello. I am Hikari Itsuki, the developer.

I have decided to change the release date of “Magic Potion Liberators” back to undecided.
For those of you who were hoping for a release by the end of 2024, I apologize..!
We will announce the release date when the production is almost finished and we have a firm idea of when it will be released.

I'll be posting progress updates on the X page, so if you are interested, please check it out!

https://x.com/ARTIFACTS_DEV
